name: Adler Planetarium
address: 1300 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
tagline: Three theaters under one roof, including an actual astrophysics-grade dome. Skyline view alone is worth it.
description: America's first planetarium, opened in 1930 on a peninsula extending into Lake Michigan. Three full-dome theaters plus rotating exhibits on cosmology, telescopes, and space exploration. The view back at the skyline is one of the best in the city.

tips.text: The skyline shot from the south terrace is best near sunset.
Combo tickets with Field Museum or Shedd save ~25%.

highlights.item: 20-projector dome — most advanced in the country
